title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization?
description: Is China really the most responsible country for the world's CO2 emission? This project practices using deceptive techniques in data visualization to (dis)prove this proposition.

title: Grocery Store Price Comparison
description: Between Target, Walmart, and Whole Foods, people tend to think that Whole Foods is the most expensive yet also the healthiest grocery store — is that really true?

title: Reddit Post Subreddit Prediction
description: Group project for DSC 232R, which practices using distributed computing to analyze and train a classification model.

title: How much does CO2 emission affect climate change?
description: Explore a potential cause of one of the temperature changes, greenhouse gas emission, through interactive data visualizaiton.

title: ILLNESS, An Alternative Way To Assess Wildfire Risk
description: UCSD Data Science Capstone Project. The ILLNESS Model is a multi-factor machine learning model designed to enhance the accuracy of PSPS decisions in order to mitigate wildfire risks.

title: Wildfire Risk Assessment and Mitigation
description: Wildfire Risk Assessment and Mitigation report in collaboration with SDG&E.
